title: Chowringhee

vibeProfile.oneLine: Life behind the facade of a grand Calcutta hotel, in a beloved Bengali novel.

summary: Chowringhee is Sankar's hugely popular Bengali novel set in a grand Calcutta hotel, whose lobbies, rooms and staff become a stage for the whole comedy and tragedy of the city's life. Through the eyes of a young new employee, we meet a rich cast of guests and workers whose stories of love, ambition, loneliness and loss unfold behind the hotel's glamorous facade. Warm, bustling and bittersweet, it is a beloved portrait of mid-century Calcutta.
whyReadIt: A beloved Bengali novel set in a grand Calcutta hotel, a whole city's life behind the glamour. Warm and bittersweet.

funFacts.text: It was adapted into a classic Bengali film and later a long-running play.
